(viii) STRING-MATCHING A CLAIM'S QUOTATIONS AND NUMBERS DOES NOT TEST ITS QUANTIFIER OR ITS SCOPE -- ctr-0012 is the clean counterexample to its sufficiency: EVERY stored string in src-0004 matched exactly and string-matching found nothing, because the defect was entirely in WHAT WAS NOT STORED.
